voices.name: l00
voices.text: Is life hard right now? <#0.3#> Then try seeing it this way.
voices.caption: Is life hard right now? Then try seeing it this way.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Every game has obstacles, <#0.2#> and a boss to beat.
voices.caption: Every game has obstacles, and a boss to beat.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: A game with no obstacles at all <#0.2#> would be boring.
voices.caption: A game with no obstacles at all would be boring.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: A player doesn't quit at an obstacle. <#0.2#> They watch, change strategy, and level up.
voices.caption: A player doesn't quit at an obstacle. They watch, change strategy, and level up.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Hardship isn't game over. <#0.2#> It's the door to the next stage.
voices.caption: Hardship isn't game over. It's the door to the next stage.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: You set the rules of this game. <#0.3#> Play your own.
voices.caption: You set the rules of this game. Play your own.
